Important info about the values:
The game uses two different values:

Display Value – does not include the 2x chance upgrades (Product Doubler, Double Petal I, Double Petal II)
 Uncapped Value this has Random Modifier – this is what the game actually uses to calculate how many crops you get. It includes a Random Modifier, so sometimes you’ll get more and sometimes less.

The Crop Value shown on the site includes all bonuses for both caps and max value. These are the only values the game uses for calculations.

content:
So I'd recommend something where it reads all your base Evo from non-LR (Land Ranks) sources, and it tries to hit X% Evo chance on the highest crop (whether that's going for the final Glassy or Medal, I don't know, whichever it is), and having an input for what you want X% to be, whether that's 100%, 50%, whatever. If you're unable to hit above 0% on the final crop, then you can allocate points to it.

Same thing with value. Because Value has a *hard* cap of 10k that can only be increased via Exotic Market, same thing as Evo, getting up to your capped value is all you need. I don't know how many LR I need to invest to hit my cap and going over my cap is effectively worthless points; the optimizer should know how I hit that cap value though.

From there, having us then divvy out the rest of the points as we wish to on OG, LR EXP, and Farming EXP as it does currently. I think that would go a long way towards it truly optimizing your Evo and Value at least.

Hopefully that all made sense! (I'm bad at words lol) <:grumblo_thumbsup:1101692875248521366>

Update :
How to Use:

Paste your JSON data into the input field and press Load.
Select the companions you have from the list.
Select the lab bonuses you have active.
Enter your tome manual data.
Enter your vote bonus.

Changelog:

Fully implemented bonus stats for Evolution and Crop Value.
Added threshold display so you can see the % of the true max you are currently at.
(Later: target threshold will be added to show levels needed.)
Added local storage so your manual inputs are remembered and don’t need to be selected every time.
Removed custom crop counts. Instead, exposed the actual variables that can be edited, with results updating in real time.
Exposed talent levels so they can be edited to experiment with the data. Later I will expose all other relevant levels so users can simulate different setups.
Completely restructured the old bonus tree. All bonuses are now grouped exactly how the engine uses them (additive bonuses shown with +, multiplicative with ×).

Some engine errors discovered:

The game incorrectly displays talent points. I cloned its actual function to calculate bonus levels for talents — you actually get more than what the game shows you.
Certified Stamp Book uses a condition that always fails, therefore it never applies its bonus to the Evolution stamp.
Button uses the incorrect bonus for crop value calculations (Spelunk instead of Evo).

Next up:

Implement OG, Growth Speed, and Soil Exp bonuses
Expose all values for users to edit
Create optimizer for land ranks as well as other farming bonuses
Create “Other Bonuses Affecting Farming” section that displays all relevant multipliers and their thresholds
